name: Eric A. Navarrette
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Denton, Texas
education: Texas Tech University School of Law
about: Attorney Eric A. Navarrette is a shareholder with Navarrette Family Law, P.C., law firm in Denton, Texas. A nationally ranked lawyer with more than 15 years of legal experience, Mr. Navarrette focuses his practice exclusively on family law, and he provides unmatched counsel and support to clients throughout Denton and Tarrant counties who have legal needs involving divorce, child custody and support, property division, relocation, grandparents' rights, prenuptial and postnuptial agreements, protective orders and more.

A highly seasoned litigator and well-versed in collaborative law, Mr. Navarrette holds his board certification in family law from the Texas Board of Legal Specialization, and he is able to help his clients through their contested or uncontested divorces while consistently maintaining an unwavering commitment to protecting their rights and interests at all turns.

From his efforts, he has achieved remarkable success helping his clients obtain the favorable outcomes they seek for their serious and complex family-related legal issues efficiently and cost-effectively, and he has gained a reputation for his compassion and integrity as well as his impassioned advocacy on behalf of his clients.

Honored for his impeccable professionalism and outstanding client service, Mr. Navarrette has received perennial recognition from The Best Lawyers in America as well as a "Superb" rating on Avvo and numerous testimonials and referrals from those he has served.

A 2003 graduate of St. Mary's University with a degree in criminal justice, Mr. Navarrette obtained his Juris Doctor degree from Texas Tech University School of Law in 2006. He has several publications to his credit, and he is an active member of the Texas Academy of Family Law Specialists, the Dallas County Bar Association's Family Law Section and the Denton County Bar Association.

He has also served as president of the Denton County Young Lawyers Association as well as director of Denton County Collaborative Professionals, and he is active with many other local, state and national legal organizations.
